title: Sync cockpit mod version strings with 0.17.0 crate bump
body:
**Chose:** bump `mods/cockpit/hooks/register.tsx` and `mods/cockpit/tests/cockpit.test.tsx` to `0.17.0` alongside the crate bump.
**Over:** leaving them at `0.16.0` and blocking on `the_mod_carries_the_crates_version`.
**Because:** `tests/cockpit_mod.rs` requires the cockpit mod to match `CARGO_PKG_VERSION`; slice 03 listed only `plugin.json` but the prior release did both.
**Undo:** revert those two version strings with the crate bump.

title: denied.json: line-parse assert_denied literals, not regex the whole block
body: Regex-based extraction from assert_denied blocks grabbed comment-adjacent quote fragments as commands; parse one string literal per line instead.
